questions: Should the function handle non-numeric columns (e.g., strings, categories) by raising an error, converting, or skipping?
If the column contains NaN values, should they be silently dropped, raise an error, or propagate?
Should the x-axis label always be exactly the column name, or should it be customizable?
Is the fitted distribution always a normal distribution (norm), or should it adapt to data shape?
Should the function close or show the plot, or just return the Axes object?
If density=False, should the fitted curve still be a probability density (integrating to 1) or match histogram scaling?
Should the title always be exactly 'Normal Fit for "{column}"' or allow customization?
If the column is empty (no data points), should the function raise an error, return empty Axes, or handle gracefully?
